title: payment-api: elevated latency and errors
description: Synthetic monitor: payment-api p95 latency reached 8.3s (normally ~217ms) and error rate peaked at 40.7%.
root_cause_detail: External dependency acquirer-gateway degraded and responded slowly; payment-api calls exceeded the 8000ms client timeout.
expected_symptoms: payment-api downstream_latency_ms rises from ~223ms to ~8.3s (client timeout 8000ms)
timeout and retry logs on calls from payment-api to acquirer-gateway
payment-api p95 latency rises to ~8.3s, error rate up to ~40.7%
payment-api CPU and memory stay near baseline
payment-api db_connection_utilization moderately elevated (~79%) but not saturated
resolution: Failed over to the secondary acquirer-gateway region and tuned the payment-api timeout and retry budget.
